article.title: Government jobs as arts subsidy
article.excerpt: Often governments support the arts best when they are intent on some other purpose: The very existence of government jobs subsidizes the arts. Even in the best of times, most writers find it difficult to make a living from book sales alone. Many accept government jobs, hoping they will have time to pursue their own projects.
